title: ArtAnimator - Animation Maker
summary: Frame by frame, bring it to life. Draw, animate & export MP4, GIF with ease.
description:
ArtAnimator is a powerful frame-by-frame animation app that lets you create stunning 2D animations right on your phone. Whether you're a beginner or a professional animator, ArtAnimator gives you all the tools you need to bring your ideas to life.

DRAWING TOOLS
• 24+ professional brushes including Pen, Pencil, Airbrush, Crayon, Calligraphy, Marker, and more
• Shape tools: Line, Rectangle, Circle with fill options
• Color picker with full palette and custom colors
• Adjustable brush size and opacity
• Eraser and flood fill tools
• Text tool with multiple fonts

ANIMATION
• Intuitive frame-by-frame timeline
• Onion skin overlay to see previous and next frames
• Add, duplicate, and reorder frames easily
• Adjustable FPS for smooth playback
• Ghost trail for motion visualization

LAYERS
• Multi-layer support for each frame
• Layer visibility, opacity, and reorder controls
• Merge layers for easy organization

AUDIO
• Record audio directly with your microphone
• Import audio files from your device
• Multiple audio tracks with volume control
• Sync audio with your animation playback

EXPORT & SHARE
• Export as MP4 video in HD quality
• Export as GIF animation
• Export as PNG image sequence
• Share your animations directly to social media

CANVAS OPTIONS
• Multiple canvas presets: YouTube 1080p, TikTok, Instagram, and custom sizes
• Grid overlay for precise drawing
• Zoom and pan for detailed work
• Reference image import for tracing

ADDITIONAL FEATURES
• Undo and redo support
• Copy, paste, and cut frames
• Select and transform drawn objects
• Mirror and symmetry drawing mode
• Demo project included to get started
• Clean, intuitive white interface

Create professional-quality animations with ArtAnimator. Download now and start animating!

description:
Scout is a fast, powerful Amazon FBA, FBM profit calculator for retail arbitrage and online arbitrage sellers. Scan any product barcode or enter an Amazon ASIN to instantly see if it's worth flipping.

WHAT YOU GET

- Barcode Scanner — Point your camera at any product barcode for instant Amazon lookup
- ASIN Lookup — Paste any Amazon ASIN directly to check a product
- Amazon FBA Profit Calculator — See your estimated profit after Amazon fees (referral, fulfillment, closing)
- Verdict System — Clear FLIP, RISKY, or SKIP verdict on every scan
- Amazon Best Sellers Rank (BSR) — Full category rankings to gauge demand
- Amazon Demand Badge — See how many units sold in the past month
- Amazon Seller Competition — FBA/FBM seller count, who owns the Amazon buybox
- Sold by Amazon Detection — Know when Amazon itself is competing on the listing
- Haul List — Save every scan, add notes, search, filter, sort, and export to CSV
- Customizable Thresholds — Set your own minimum profit and margin for verdicts
- US ZIP Location — Configure delivery ZIP to get accurate Amazon US pricing

PRO FEATURES

Upgrade to Scout Pro for the ultimate Amazon scanning experience:
- Unlimited scans — no daily limit
- Completely ad-free
- AI-powered insights on every scan
- Unlimited rescan anytime

WHO IS THIS FOR

- Amazon FBA retail arbitrage sellers scanning products in stores
- Amazon FBA online arbitrage sellers evaluating products from home
- Amazon resellers who want quick profit calculations before buying
- Anyone looking to start selling on Amazon FBA

Scout works with the Amazon US marketplace (amazon.com). For best results from outside the US, use a VPN with a US location.

All Amazon product data is fetched in real-time for accuracy. No Amazon seller account required.

title: Remote Mouse Pro - Use full PC
summary: Wireless touchpad / mouse , keyboard, voice & file transfer for your Windows PC.
description:
Remote Mouse Pro turns your phone into a wireless touchpad, keyboard, voice assistant and file remote for your Windows PC. Pair once over Wi-Fi, then control your computer from the couch, the bed, or across the room.

Built for people who actually use a PC: developers, content creators, presenters, and anyone who is tired of getting up to skip a song or close a tab.

— FEATURES —

• Precision touchpad with multi-finger gestures, scroll, right-click and drag
• Full software keyboard with modifier keys (Ctrl, Alt, Shift, Win) and shortcut macros
• Wake-on-LAN — power your PC on from your phone
• Multi-monitor aware: switch monitors with a tap
• Discover PCs on your network with zero-config mDNS — no IP typing
• Encrypted local-network connection with one-time pairing token

— PRO FEATURES (3-day free trial) —

• OCR — point your phone camera at any text, instantly paste it into the active PC window
• Voice macros — speak commands and trigger keyboard shortcuts on your PC
• Live snippets — keep a clipboard library on your phone, paste with one tap
• File transfer — push files from your phone to your PC, or pull files from your PC to your phone's Downloads folder
• Foreground app awareness — context-aware shortcuts that adapt to whatever app you have focused

— PRIVACY-FIRST —

Remote Mouse Pro runs entirely on your local Wi-Fi. There is no cloud, no analytics, no account. Your input never leaves your network. The Windows server is open about every byte it sends and receives — see thecodebage.com for the full transparency report.

— REQUIREMENTS —

• Windows 10 or 11 PC with the free Remote Mouse Pro server installed (download from thecodebage.com)
• Both devices on the same Wi-Fi network

descriptionHTML:
Remote Mouse Pro turns your phone into a wireless touchpad, keyboard, voice assistant and file remote for your Windows PC. Pair once over Wi-Fi, then control your computer from the couch, the bed, or across the room.

Built for people who actually use a PC: developers, content creators, presenters, and anyone who is tired of getting up to skip a song or close a tab.

— FEATURES —

• Precision touchpad with multi-finger gestures, scroll, right-click and drag
• Full software keyboard with modifier keys (Ctrl, Alt, Shift, Win) and shortcut macros
• Wake-on-LAN — power your PC on from your phone
• Multi-monitor aware: switch monitors with a tap
• Discover PCs on your network with zero-config mDNS — no IP typing
• Encrypted local-network connection with one-time pairing token

— PRO FEATURES (3-day free trial) —

• OCR — point your phone camera at any text, instantly paste it into the active PC window
• Voice macros — speak commands and trigger keyboard shortcuts on your PC
• Live snippets — keep a clipboard library on your phone, paste with one tap
• File transfer — push files from your phone to your PC, or pull files from your PC to your phone's Downloads folder
• Foreground app awareness — context-aware shortcuts that adapt to whatever app you have focused

— PRIVACY-FIRST —

Remote Mouse Pro runs entirely on your local Wi-Fi. There is no cloud, no analytics, no account. Your input never leaves your network. The Windows server is open about every byte it sends and receives — see thecodebage.com for the full transparency report.

— REQUIREMENTS —

• Windows 10 or 11 PC with the free Remote Mouse Pro server installed (download from thecodebage.com)
• Both devices on the same Wi-Fi network
• Android 7.0 (Nougat) or later
